meta.reset: Reset DB, cache and search index to `fixtures` before every case. Fixture objects are flat: one object per translation (posts: per (post_id, language); categories and editors: per (slug, language)). Entity-level fields (created_at, created_by, published_at, views, author, categories on posts; hidden/navbar on categories; deleted_at on editors) are repeated identically on every row of the same entity. Ids of posts and ads are the ones given in the fixtures; new entities get the next sequential id. Editors are bound to a fixture user: editor.slug equals editor.username equals the user's username, and the public `email` is the user's email. Actor rows are seeded by the harness (permissions = session mask). Public routes are called as `anonymous` (no Authorization header) unless a case says otherwise. Fixture timestamps are either far in the past (published/expired) or far in the future (2100+) so results do not depend on the wall clock.
meta.actor: Key into fixtures.actors, or: anonymous (no Authorization header), garbage_session (invalid Authorization header). `root` is used for admin side steps and for authenticated calls.
meta.request: path_params are unescaped and must be percent-encoded when substituted. `path` may carry a literal query string that is already percent-encoded (e.g. /public/advertisements?groups=a,b&groups=c). headers: null removes a default header; an empty string sends an empty header. Default Accept-Language is `en` on routes that require it. body_raw (even empty string) overrides body. body_generator {json_padded_bytes: N, base} = valid JSON of exactly N bytes, padded with an unknown field.
meta.tokens: {$const: NAME} constants; {$repeat: {s, n}}; {$email_of_length: N}; {$raw_session: actor} session id without Bearer; {$actor_perms: actor} the actor's permission mask. Tokens appear only as direct field values (body, headers, path_params, assertion value).
meta.json_assertions: List of {path, op, value}. ops: eq, ne, type, len_eq, len_lte, gte, includes, excludes, is_null, not_null, unix_or_null, sorted_asc, sorted_desc. Paths with [*] resolve to lists. Path `$` is the whole response body (len_eq on an object counts its keys). is_null passes for both a missing field and an explicit null. A top-level key that is a group name (e.g. `partners`) is addressed directly.
meta.eventually_ms: Retry the step until it passes or the timeout elapses (indexing is async).
meta.note: Free-text explanation of the assumption behind a case. Present on every case tagged `ambiguous` and on some inferred ones.
meta.source: documented = rules inside the source_document; stated = rules given outside the docs (ads priority order, 406/413/415 conventions); inferred = derived from code (strings.go), sibling modules or conventions.
meta.tags: boundary, cache, security, regression, verify_normalisation (needs case-folding), verify_clamp (ClampParams behaviour), undocumented_limit (limit comes from strings.go, not the docs), assumes_sequential_id (the case reads back a created post as id 6 = max fixture id + 1; the harness cannot capture ids), ambiguous (docs are silent/contradictory or the outcome depends on an assumption; expectation chosen by common sense, see note).
